name: ModernInfoPanel
title: Modern Info Panel
author: Gabriel Dungan (DunganSoft Technologies)
description: Configurable corner HUD panels for Rust: clock, rotating announcements, balance, points, coordinates, compass, online/sleeper counts and live event indicators (airdrop, helicopter, chinook, cargo ship, bradley, radiation). Oxide and Carbon compatible, with a reflection-free API for custom panels.

permissions.name: moderninfopanel.admin
permissions.description: Allows 'mipanel reload' and 'mipanel import' (import an existing InfoPanel config) from chat, console, or RCON (the server console and RCON are always authorized).

commands.description: Universal command (chat /mipanel, in-game F1 console, server console, and RCON as 'mipanel ...'). Manage your panel (hide/show, clock mode/offset, time format); 'reload' and 'import' are admin/server-only and work from any context.
